Spiders infesting your [i]multiverse.[/i]

[b]Pro:[/b] Larger and more complex levels spread out across the entire multiverse.
[b]Con:[/b] Larger and more complex spiders spread out across the entire multiverse.

[b]Con: [/b]It’s been 2020 since we launched the last game, and the spiders have found a whole host of new ways not to be murdered.

[b]Pro:[/b] A brand new and more thorough story told in the form of fully voiced audio logs and even songs
[b]Cons:[/b] Audio logs and songs may be so engaging that you let your guard down while enjoying them and find a spider has landed in your hair/sandwich. [/h2]

notes.title: Halloween Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween, exterminators!

Trick or treat, the Kill It With Fire Halloween Update is here!  I hope you’re not afraid of the dark because the lights have gone out in the first three missions!  It’s your job to investigate, but don’t expect any clear answers!  Instead, you’ll find new objectives, new Arachno-gauntlets, and a new type of spider: the GHOST SPIDER!  A trio of new rewards exist for exterminators who brave the darkness.  Keep reading for more details!

[previewyoutube=C3sehHxuA7U;full][/previewyoutube]

First, let’s address the elephant in the room: the darkness.  With the exception of a certain level towards the end of the game,  Kill It With Fire is a bright and friendly game (well, aside from the spiders I guess). These missions ain’t like that:  they’re DARK dark.  Fortunately, all of your fire-based weapons now illuminate your surroundings!  I’ve also swapped the locations of the Flashlight and Protein Shake upgrades so the Flashlight is now the FIRST upgrade you find!  Don’t forget to use it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/63036f0e057f17811c1f393702f4e77a174c0eb3.png[/img]

Next, let’s talk spiders:  do they have souls?  It turns out the answer is YES.  Most spiders you kill while playing with Halloween Mode enabled will spawn a Ghost Spider (zombie spiders won’t because zombies don’t have souls - duh!).  Ghost spiders can’t be defeated the same way as regular spiders.  There is a way to defeat them, but you’ll need to find it for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/d8bb20d82a345fd2af418ea802ba92fcae3fd0ea.png[/img]

In addition to the new Halloween content, I’ve also created a new system called Modifiers.  Most of these already existed (Spider Noir, Low Gravity, Goose Mode, etc) but I’ve re-organized them in a new menu so they’re much easier to manage.  A row of icons now display which modifiers you’ve enabled at a glance!  Handy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/00c1c80f64de6af16ac8844c9ea6dc4f3020f895.png[/img]

The modifiers menu is also how you enable the new Halloween mode!  It doesn’t cost any upgrade points, but you do need to complete the “regular” version of each mission first.  Also, Christmas has come early this year for exterminators that have been extra naughty - you can now enable Holiday Mode all year round for any mission that supports it!  It’s a Halloween miracle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/cfdc2ccf07d8ea5e316061a597cefc3e70d5342a.gif[/img]

So what do you get for braving the darkness?  There are three new rewards available (one per mission) for exterminators who complete EVERYTHING in each Halloween Mode mission.  First up is the Airhorn, a new piece of equipment.  Forget methodically searching for spiders - blast this bad boy to get the attention of every arachnid in a 50 mile radius!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/0d2ec5b49557543a9dc3362c282f58baf25313ac.gif[/img]

Next is a new modifier - Australia Mode!  Don’t worry, it doesn’t make the game upside down (although I did consider that…) - it makes the spiders TWICE AS BIG!  Honestly, it’s a lot more terrifying than I expected.  If a double sized jumping spider flies at your face, you just might fall out of your seat.  You’ve been warned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/e58e48ca16e77903e7b286d5e2047b33fb75573a.png[/img]

Finally, there’s a new tracker upgrade: the Secret Sniffer Pro.  It requires both the S.P.I.D.A.R. and Secret Sniffer to use it, but it’s well worth the batteries.  With the Secret Sniffer Pro, you’ll see the location of secrets on your tracker’s radar screen!  It’s super handy for finding that last Omega File, battery, or blacklight clue you’ve been looking for!

One last thing - if you haven’t already grabbed Kill It With Fire now is a great time to pick it up!  From now until November 1st you can get it for 75% off!  If you’re just catching up with the game for the first time since launch, I’ve released a ton of other FREE content updates:

[list]
[*] Omega Files: new gear and secrets!
[*] Holiday Update: decorate a tree in each mission to get new equipment and upgrades
[*] Anniversary Update: a whole new level, new gear, and a massive puzzle!
[/list]

That’s it for now, exterminators!  I hope you have fun with all of the new content!  Good luck and Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Community Event Wrap-Up
notes.content:
Hello exterminators!

KIWF has now been updated to allow exterminators to solve the community event puzzle on their own.  It works exactly the same way: get the blacklight and search for hidden clues in every level except “Down the Spider Hole”.  But, rather than report your clues to Discord you’ll just use them on the code grid in the secret bunker.  Everyone has their own random code.  If you’ve already solved the puzzle, you don’t need to do anything - unless you decide to start a new save file!

[h2]Save Files[/h2]

Over the last couple weeks I’ve heard scattered reports of players losing their save files.  I haven’t been able to get to the bottom of the issue, but I have created a way to restore your save.  Right click on Kill It With Fire in your Steam library and choose “Properties”.  On the menu that appears there should be a field labeled “Launch Options”  (If you don’t see it, make sure you’re on the “General” tab).  In the “Launch Options” field, enter the following EXACTLY (minus the quotes): “-AutoCompleteLevels X”.  Now, replace X with the number of the level you’d like to complete the game through.  For example, if you’d like to complete Domestic Duties, replace X with 3.  To complete the entire game, replace X with 10.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/f2758bf0ce2a9c328280ae121b9f70a47f44ea38.png[/img]

Once you launch the game, it should automatically adjust your save file to 100% complete those levels.  That means beating the level, completing all objectives, unlocking all doors, discovering all equipment/upgrades/batteries/files, and completing the Arachno-Gauntlet.  This will only work in the first save slot.  Once you’ve restored your save, please close the game and delete what you’ve entered into “Launch Options”.  

[h2]What else is new?[/h2]

I’ve adjusted the spider’s AI so they behave much less predictably.  Skip to the next paragraph if you’re uninterested in the guts of how KIWF works.  Still with me?  Great!  Previously, the spiders moved at random between a series of “hand placed” points.  If you ever killed a huge number of spiders in a small space, you may have picked up on this.  The change I’ve made allows spiders to instead choose a random destination around those points within a radius defined by the point (a large radius for a point in the middle of the room, a small radius for a point on top of a shelf, etc).  It makes the spiders seem more unpredictable and I love the results.  Let me know what you think!  Also, if you see any spiders running into walls please let me know so I can sort ‘em out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/97282d5ef6a6a13dbff56799924b5d8afda28867.png[/img]

I’ve fixed a few other bugs here and there.  You shouldn’t be able to get on the mower while using the spider tracker (that crashed the game before - oops!).  Also, if you’ve already completed the “Fix Electrical Problem” objective in Major Inconvenience, you should find the door already open next time you load into the level.

I think that wraps it up for now.  I hope everyone enjoyed the community event.  And, if you missed it, I hope you enjoy the new version of the puzzle!  What do you want to see next for Kill It With Fire?  Let me know on [url=https://twitter.com/caseydonnellan]Twitter (and smush that follow button)[/url] or come say hello in the [url=discord.com/invite/killitwithfire]Discord[/url].

Until next time!

Casey

notes.title: Anniversary Update is here!
notes.content:
Rev up your engines, exterminators - the Anniversary Update is here!  It has been an amazing year for Kill It With Fire and Casey Donnellan Games, so I wanted to do something special for everyone who has joined me on this spider roasting journey.  

There’s an entire NEW LEVEL for you to rid of spiders along with new gear, upgrades, achievements, and the first ever Kill It With Fire “Community Event.”  Let’s break it down - if you’re worried about spoilers, stop reading now!

[h2]Last warning![/h2]

The new mission, [b]“Down the Spider Hole”[/b] takes place just after “Domestic Duties” and allows you to explore the yard around the house from the first three missions.  As you may have guessed, it’s lousy with spiders.  Fortunately, with a new level comes new opportunities for spider murdering mayhem.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/9059e99fced8d4d34d011fe995cfbd735a05b03b.gif[/img]

A new cheese puff flavor is on the scene: [b]Best Buds Blueberry[/b]. “Ew, blueberry cheese puffs?” Well it turns out spiders have less discerning palettes.  Get one to chow down and they’ll become your new BFF.  These [b]Spider Bros[/b] know your heart’s desire and will mercilessly pursue any spider they see.  And don’t worry - if you tire of your spider army you can always relieve them of duty...permanently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/a3432d567f379a2b08077e2f35b345c5fea1815e.gif[/img]

This was added during the “Omega Files” update last year and available during the epilogue mission, once you completed enough Arachno-Gauntlets.  It’s so much fun, though, I’ve decided to move it to earlier in the game.  You’re also gonna need it during the new mission to find everything…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/4701f3a44875072750ed3c84e5175f05ca9357ac.gif[/img]

All that lawn and nobody home to mow - it would be neighborly to “borrow” their [b]Mower[/b] and tidy up. If some spiders get in the way...well, isn’t there an old saying about throwing rocks at birds?  This isn’t your grandpa’s old push mower - you’re getting a riding lawnmower with serious horsepower.  Still not enough speed?  Equip the NOS upgrade to go fast and make the spiders furious.  Once you’re done mowing the lawn, take her for a spin in the other missions!

That brings us to the Community Event.  I won’t get into specifics, even for people who want spoilers, but I will say a few things.  To get started, look for something NEW where the Drone was previously located.  After that, you’ll need to combine your clues with other Exterminators to find the answer. 
 [url=https://discord.com/invite/killitwithfire]Make sure you join the Discord - that’s where it’s all gonna happen![/url]

[*] Added “Echolocator” tracker upgrade

notes.title: Update #1: The Omega Files!
notes.content:
Hello spider hunters!

Kill It With Fire 1.1  is now available and with it comes some pretty big changes to your favorite spider hunting simulator: new equipment, a new spider variant, special settings for arachnophobes, overhauled gamepad support, multiple save slots, and (of course!) the Omega Files!  Let’s break it down:

[h3]Omega Files[/h3]

If you’ve already played KIWF you may have discovered some random manilla folders featuring the omega symbol, the last letter of the Greek alphabet.  Well, I hope you remember where you found them because now you can collect and read them to discover the answers to some of the game’s many mysteries.  For instance: why are there so many spiders? Where are all the people?  And what’s the deal with the cheese puffs?

[h3]Vacuum[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/ce8711823b8b751b8f9b936bc0bf27ca9d796890.gif[/img]

Next, let’s talk equipment.  There are two new weapons added in the update.  The first is the vacuum.  You can use the vacuum to “suck up” just about anything laying around, including spiders.  Then you can switch the vacuums direction and shoot it all back out.  You can find the vacuum in “Domestic Duties”, appropriately enough.

[h3]Drone[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/11133afa7a4c9ac314b6656ec6d2e5b3c3ede84b.gif[/img]

The second new weapon is a remote-controlled drone with a bomb strapped to it.  While you’re flying the drone, use its thermal vision camera to locate spiders, then swoop in and self-destruct.  The drone is available in “Consequences”.

[h3]Arachnophobia Settings[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/50596b5cbe35704e9130d33b89cbab0d45b56048.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/61d8d2698ce531ead08390606f54cdbc4bfeb5ec.png[/img]

Are you terrified of spiders?  If so, I have good news.  Kill It With Fire now features special options for people with arachnophobia.  Simply open the settings menu (from the main menu or in-game) and customize the options to your liking.  You can disable “scary spiders” to make them look more blobby and less spider-like as well as disable their SFX, the jumpscare sounds, and creepy music.  Please let me know whether or not these settings helped you to enjoy the game!  Are there any other settings you’d like to see? Accessibility is always an ongoing conversation and this is just a first step!

[h3]Supplyder[/h3]

Kill It With Fire actually came out a couple of weeks ago, but it’s one of a bunch of games that publisher tinyBuild brought to showcase at PAX X EGX, and I decided to push my personal limits by playing it. I was surprised to find my time with Kill It With Fire quite liberating, albeit worryingly so. I wasn’t afraid of the spiders at all. Instead I’d become a virtual eradicator of the eight legged kind. notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Hello exterminators!

We're one day out from launch and it seems like most of you are having a great time with Kill It With Fire!  I haven't heard about any show-stopping issues so far (knock on wood!), but I did hear about one bug that I wanted to quickly address in a patch.  If you see v1.0.16 in the bottom left corner of your screen, you'll know you've got it!

For the curious, here's what was going on.  On the second level (Close Encounters), if you picked up all five batteries before collecting the S.P.I.D.A.R. tracker upgrade, you would complete the "Power Up" objective without having first discovered it.  That by itself is fine - it happens even more in other places (such as the "Fight Spider With Spider" objective in Major Inconvenience) so I've got code that automatically deletes the objective discovery pickup upon completion of that objective.  That's good, because it means you won't later discover a random, glowing sheet of paper that doesn't do anything.

Maybe you see where this is going - the S.P.I.D.A.R. upgrade is both an objective discovery pickup AND an upgrade, so when you picked up the 5th battery the game deleted the upgrade!  And, to make matters worse the whole thing was happening again when you reloaded the level, since we want to get rid of the objective discovery pickups you've already found.

I've only heard from one player that actually encountered the issue but it's possible there are more who just haven't said anything, so it seemed best to fix it ASAP!  Another issue that I discovered along the way (and I seriously doubt this has been discovered by ANYONE, but you never know!) is that if you never pick up the hairspray in First Contact but you do pick some up in a later level, you'll be unable to complete the "Find More Firepower" objective, since it was only listening for the player to discover new equipment, not find more ammo.  Of course, the game is called KILL IT WITH FIRE, so who in their right mind would skip grabbing the hairspray in the first level?!?!

That's all for today!  I'll just leave you guys with these awesome articles about the game.  They really made my day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/711825f6f2d930c4b338b11c9627ebda66ed38e6.png[/img]

Kill It With Fire comes out in less than two weeks.  AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!  I'm going to be busy making minor improvements, fixing bugs, and doing some performance optimization through next week.  It's so, so close to being ready and I can't wait for everyone to see it!

So instead of showing more equipment, spiders, or levels I decided to talk about something completely new today: ACHIEVEMENTS!  Kill It With Fire will launch on Steam with 24 achievements.  Some of them are easy to get, others...not so much.  All achievement art was done by Cara Curley ([url=https://twitter.com/IDrawCaraLines]@IDrawCaraLines[/url]).  She also created all of the equipment icons and the in-game portraits.  You might have seen one of her on a certain fireplace...

Let's look at a few of 'em.  If you don't want to know what the achievements are, abandon this post while ye can!  You've been warned.

[b]Spick and Span[/b] - Destroy EVERY dish in Domestic Duties.

Good luck with them, especially the dish achievement.  You might need think outside the box to get it... 

That's enough for now!  A few non-achievement updates:

First, I'm changing the way spiders respond to cheese puffs.  Previously, only certain spiders would go after particular flavors of cheese puff.  Specifically, they would only try to eat them if they could transform from doing so and they would only transform into more "advanced" forms.  That's all gone now - every spider will pursue every flavor and can transform into any other type.

Next, I've put a limit on how long spiders will get spooked for.  Previously, if you hit a spider or fired a gun near it, they would speed up and stay at that speed until they died, or found a new hiding spot.  They'll now only get a speed boost for a few seconds.

Some of the later levels are a bit darker.  There's a flashlight upgrade, but for players who didn't find it, I've put a tiny white dot in the middle of the aiming reticle; it's subtle, but I found that it really helps to aim in low light situations.

Finally, I've moved the upgrade equip menu to the mission preview (where you click "PLAY") for easier access.  In addition, I've created a little "breadcrumb" system to tell you about new upgrades you haven't looked at yet.

notes.title: Exploding Spider
notes.content:
What's up, exterminators?

If you played Ignition when it first came out, you may recall that spiderlings were originally red, after the first patch, they changed to white.  Why?  I decided to make an [i]exploding spider[/i] and, according to the most hallowed video game traditions, things that explode when you shoot them [b]must[/b] be red.

So, without further ado - THE EXPLODING SPIDER!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/ed5726bbec55cd779f3fee829c3c729e0820a8c6.gif[/img]


How does it work?  Simple - kill this spider and (after a short charge-up) it explodes.  The explosion can knock stuff around, set stuff on fire, and even kill other spiders!  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748212/dfa488a0251ed630e2734a8f11b386a360b6c30d.gif[/img]


The exploding spider is different from others in one crucial aspect - [b]it is immune to fire[/b].  That's right, your most important ally is useless here.  Fortunately, you've got A LOT of other weapons to work with!
